main.מספר בקשה: kpi:requests, chart-budget, chart-programs — requests counted per budget year and per program
main.תיאור בקשה: skip: free text per request; the program is shown via תאור התקנה (searchable in the explorer)
main.ספק: skip: internal supplier number; recipients are named by מגיש הבקשה
main.מזהה ספק: skip: corporate registration number of the recipient; mirrors מגיש הבקשה
main.מגיש הבקשה: chart-recipients, chart-types, kpi:recipients, insight:top_recipient — type derived from the name prefix
main.תקנה: chart-programs — budget line code shown in the programs table
main.מח אחראית: skip: department code; mirrors שם מחלקה
main.ת. התאמה: chart-yearly, chart-pace, chart-heat, chart-lag, chart-budget, insight:ytd, insight:december — the actual transfer date
main.שולם בפועל: kpi:total, chart-yearly, chart-pace, chart-heat, chart-programs, chart-recipients, chart-types, chart-depts, chart-budget, chart-sizes, insight:sizes
main.סך מעודכן: chart-budget, insight:requests — approved request total (one value per request)
main.ת. פירעון: skip: due date tracks the payment-creation date (median gap 1 day) and holds garbage years such as 2202
main.נרשם לתש: kpi:pending, insight:pending — amount registered for payment where nothing was paid yet
main.ת.אסמכתא: skip: reference date, mirrors the eligibility date
main.יוצר תשלום: skip: names of ministry clerks who keyed the payment, 50% empty, adds nothing for readers
main.סך אבן דרך: skip: milestone total; the page uses request totals and actual payments
main.מס תשלום: skip: payment sequence number within a milestone
main.מס א ד: skip: milestone sequence number within a request
main.ת.יצירת תש: skip: payment-creation date, within days of the transfer date (ת. התאמה is used)
